detail: isolated profile dev-keystore.json has an empty secrets map by design (ISOLATION_MAP.md 2.4); vy.py openrouter path requires a key even for a :free slug and exits before any network call without --no-key, and with --no-key the sidecar OpenAI-compatible adapter itself 400s with 'OpenAIError: Missing credentials' before reaching OpenRouter. This is an environment constraint of the round-3 isolated profile, not a product defect. See rc1-scenarios-openrouter-nokey-probe.log for the empirical probe (one shared probe covers all cells; the failure is structural, not per-scenario).
